class.name: NNBTLookAt3D
class.brief_description: Action leaf that smoothly rotates a [Node3D] to face a target.
class.description: Turns [member rotated_node] (or the root's actor if unset) toward the target configured by [member NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.target_source] at up to [member turn_rate] radians per second. Returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while turning, [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] once within [member angle_tolerance], and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if the target or node is missing. By default, [member yaw_only] rotates only around the global Y axis for grounded characters; disable it for full 3D aiming.

members.member: Remaining angle in radians at or below which the node is considered facing the target.
Optional [Node3D] to rotate (for example, a head or turret child). Defaults to the root's actor.
Global target position when [member NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.target_source] is [constant NNBTSpatialActionLeaf.TARGET_POSITION].
Maximum turn speed in radians per second. Set to [code]0[/code] to snap immediately.
If [code]true[/code], faces +Z toward the target instead of -Z (matching [method Node3D.look_at]).
If [code]true[/code], rotates only around the global Y axis (ignoring target height). If [code]false[/code], pitches and yaws in full 3D.
